claim_boundary: This bounded experiment compares direct fixed-MNSol-geometry ORCA 6.1.0/openCOSMO-RS 24a results with six already-frozen fixed-source PCM-family baselines on the same ten selected experimental MNSol rows. It is a training-domain reproduction diagnostic because the published openCOSMO-RS 24a parameterization used the Marenich/Minnesota solvation data. It does not test independent generalization, the full published conformer/geometry workflow, Route-2 self-consistency, forces, a smooth solution-phase PES, or a production default.

comparison_baseline.comparison_scope: Paired total-solvation errors on the identical frozen MNSol rows; scientific representations and fitted-data exposure are not equivalent.

decision_rule.failure: Any dataset, selection, executable, version, baseline, asset, completion, temperature, unit, finiteness, privacy, or completeness gate failure invalidates the run.
decision_rule.interpretation: The three preregistered smokes are inspected before deciding whether to spend the full ten-record budget. No aliases, geometry policy, thresholds, records, or comparison baselines may change after observing results.
decision_rule.success: All requested records complete under the locked workflow and produce a private row-level artifact; only a complete ten-record run may emit a tracked aggregate artifact.

method.geometry_policy: one fixed MNSol gas-phase geometry; no conformer generation, gas optimization, conductor optimization, or solution relaxation
method.qc_level: BP86/def2-TZVPD selected by ORCA COSMORS keyword
method.standard_state_interpretation: openCOSMO-RS molar-concentration solvation free energy compared with MNSol 1 M gas to 1 M solution values

metrics.timing: ORCA wall time is metadata only; serial fixed-order measurements are not a randomized speed ranking.

privacy.complete_panel_public_output: aggregate-only; no solute names, coordinates, row-level experiments, or row-level predictions
privacy.row_level_output: must remain below .omx and must not be committed
privacy.single_record_or_smoke_subset: all outputs and work directories must remain below .omx

runtime.completion_gate: Require normal termination of the ORCA main output and every generated child .lastout; reject known failure markers even when process return code is zero.
runtime.serial_reason: The audited local MPI child launch failed while ORCA returned process code zero; serial execution completed normally.

selection.functional_group_assignment: post-selection descriptive labels frozen before this run; not selection criteria

rationale: ketone hydrogen-bond acceptor in protic ethanol
smoke_plan.stop_rule: Run and inspect only these three records after the code/preregistration commit; do not launch the full ten-record panel automatically.

training_overlap.consequence: Report descriptive errors only. Do not use this panel to claim blind generalization or superiority over methods not fitted to the same data.
training_overlap.statement: The openCOSMO-RS 24a paper reports fitting to 2129 Marenich et al. solvation free energies drawn from the Minnesota solvation data; these ten MNSol rows are therefore not an independent confirmation set.
